mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, center_code AS centerCode, grade_key AS gradeKey, status_key AS statusKey, school AS school, student_id AS studentId, student_name AS studentName, address AS address, address_detail AS addressDetail, app_id AS appId, app_password AS appPassword, app_token AS appToken, birth AS birth, profile_img AS profileImg, consult_key AS consultKey, billing_phone AS billingPhone, serial_num AS serialNum, gender AS gender, student_privacy_agree AS studentPrivacyAgree, is_hoho AS isHoho, sub_han AS subHan, sub_book AS subBook, sub_hoho AS subHoho FROM erp_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT TOP 1 id AS id, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, center_code AS centerCode, grade_key AS gradeKey, status_key AS statusKey, school AS school, student_id AS studentId, student_name AS studentName, address AS address, address_detail AS addressDetail, app_id AS appId, app_password AS appPassword, app_token AS appToken, birth AS birth, profile_img AS profileImg, consult_key AS consultKey, billing_phone AS billingPhone, serial_num AS serialNum, gender AS gender, student_privacy_agree AS studentPrivacyAgree, is_hoho AS isHoho, sub_han AS subHan, sub_book AS subBook, sub_hoho AS subHoho FROM erp_student WHERE app_id = #{appId} or serial_num = #{appId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN app_id = #{appId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT app_token FROM erp_student WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND app_token IS NOT NULL AND app_token != ''
SELECT app_token FROM erp_student WHERE app_token IS NOT NULL AND app_token != ''

SELECT TOP 20 id AS id, center_code AS centerCode, clinic_grade_key AS gradeKey, school AS school, student_id AS studentId, student_name AS studentName, app_id AS appId, billing_phone AS billingPhone FROM erp_student WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND (student_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR app_id LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%') ORDER BY student_name ASC
SELECT code AS code, codeNm AS codeNm FROM erp_bookstore_code WHERE gubun = 'S' ORDER BY code ASC

SELECT st.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, st.grade_key AS gradeKey, cd.codeNm AS gradeName, st.status_key AS statusKey, st.billing_phone AS billingPhone, st.school AS school, st.address AS address, st.address_detail AS addressDetail, st.birth AS birth, st.gender AS gender, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), st.created_at, 23) AS registeredAt, (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MAX(cs.session_date), 23) FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs WHERE cs.student_id = st.student_id) AS lastVisitDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl WHERE rl.student_id = st.student_id AND rl.status = 'DONE') AS totalDoneBooks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl WHERE rl.student_id = st.student_id AND rl.grade = 'KING') AS kingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb WHERE sb.student_id = st.student_id) AS badgeCount FROM erp_student st LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code cd ON cd.gubun = 'S' AND cd.code = st.grade_key WHERE st.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), d.record_date, 23) AS recordDate, dd.book_name AS bookName, dd.basic_correct_cnt AS basicCorrectCnt, rl.final_correct_count AS basicFinalCorrectCnt, dd.basic_total_cnt AS basicTotalCnt, dd.advanced_correct_cnt AS advancedCorrectCnt, dd.advanced_total_cnt AS advancedTotalCnt, rl.status AS status, rl.grade AS grade, d.memo AS note FROM erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd JOIN erp_bookstore_diary d ON d.diary_key = dd.diary_key LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl ON rl.recommend_id = dd.recommend_id WHERE d.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY d.record_date DESC, dd.id DESC

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), si.service_date, 23) AS serviceDate, si.seq AS seq, r.status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY si.service_date DESC, si.seq DESC

SELECT id AS id, center_code AS centerCode, grade_key AS gradeKey, school AS school, student_id AS studentId, student_name AS studentName, app_id AS appId FROM erp_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id IN ( SELECT sib2.student_id FROM erp_student_sibling sib2 WHERE sib2.sibling_key IN ( SELECT sib1.sibling_key FROM erp_student_sibling sib1 WHERE sib1.student_id = #{studentId} ) )
